pages.title: Two forms
pages.text: B has fifteen crop-form spices and five tree-form spices. Crop spices are grown from spice seeds; tree spices grow from spice saplings.

pages.title: Harvest
pages.text: Mature crop spices are harvested like other crops. Tree spices drop their product from the leaves or trunk according to their species.

pages.title: Propagation
pages.text: Crop spices use corms or roots where the species requires them; tree spices use saplings. The trellis is a decoration/support block for the tree form.

pages.title: Processing
pages.text: Spice products are ground in a stone mortar into ground spice. Ground spices are the seasoning inputs for the pan and other kitchen recipes.

pages.title: Spice product
pages.text: Mature spices drop their product. Grind it in the stone mortar.

pages.title: Ground spice
pages.text: Ground spices are the seasoning input for the pan.
